title: Mixed-mode bursting oscillations in a three-timescale biophysical neuronal oscillator model
summary: Mixed-mode oscillations (MMOs), characterized by the alternation of small-amplitude oscillations (SAOs) and large-amplitude oscillations (LAOs), and bursting oscillations are common forms of complex oscillatory dynamics observed in systems with multiple timescales and have been widely studied across scientific disciplines. Mixed-mode bursting oscillations (MMBOs) combine features of MMOs and bursting, with LAOs organized into burst events.
